subject: math
topicName: Trigonometry: Law of Cosines for SSS
description: Apply the Law of Cosines to find unknown angles when all three side lengths of a triangle are known.
learningObjectives: Recognize an SSS triangle as a Law of Cosines angle problem
Rearrange the Law of Cosines to solve for an unknown angle
Find the largest angle first by using the longest side
Use inverse cosine in degree mode to calculate triangle angles
Check that calculated angles add to about 180°
prerequisites: Cosine and inverse cosine on a calculator
Law of Cosines for finding a side
